input.summary: Ported fir.cu to SYCL 2020 in migrated/fir.cpp. It has no dpct headers, helpers or macros. It uses a 1-D nd_range, a local_accessor tile, group_barrier, and taps captured by value in the kernel in place of constant memory. It compiles with add_dpct_include=false. I ran it on a synthetic 2-channel 5000-frame WAV, and the max abs difference from the C++ reference was 6e-8. That is well within the -96 dBFS / atol 1e-5 bar. I didn't test other inputs or cutoff values.
